## Data Import & Data Wrangling

```{r wrangling, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

# 1. Import the original dataset
student_performance_por <- read_delim("student-por.csv", delim = ";", show_col_types = FALSE)

# 2. Check the variables before changing them
checks <- tibble(
  Check = c(
    "Number of students",
    "Missing activity status",
    "Missing final grade",
    "Grades outside 0–20",
    "Exact duplicate full records"
  ),
  Result = c(
    nrow(student_performance_por),
    sum(is.na(student_performance_por$activities)),
    sum(is.na(student_performance_por$G3)),
    sum(student_performance_por$G3 < 0 | student_performance_por$G3 > 20,
        na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(duplicated(student_performance_por))
  )
)

# 3. Prepare the dataset for EDA
student_clean <- student_performance_por |>
  select(activities, G3) |>
  mutate(
    activities = factor(
      activities,
      levels = c("no", "yes"),
      labels = c("No", "Yes")
    )
  )
student_clean |>
  count(activities, name = "Students") |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Extracurricular participation", "Students"),
    caption = "Sample sizes by activity participation"
  )
```
